_meta.note: controllers.ZC1: Zone A is the prototype rig's Zone 1, the actuator box (farm details form, R-1, sections 5 and 7): N, P and K on IN1-IN3 (GPIO14, 27, 26) are relay1-relay3; IN4 (GPIO25) is the water inlet. The TDS probes use the 0.5 factor (500 scale). The drums have no level sensors. gateway is the firmware's default name (MG_GATEWAY_NAME, gateway-01) for the team to confirm. Zone B, the gateway's own relays (rig Zone 2, GPIO39-41), joins with per-zone pump rates (see hardware.json).
